tool.name: nf-core pilon
tool.description: Automatically improve draft assemblies and find variation among strains, including large event detection
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ # `which` allows us to get the directory that contains `pilon`, independent of whether we # are in a container or conda environment. PILON_JAR=\$(dirname \$(which pilon))/../share/pilon*/pilon.jar java -Xmx${mem_mb}M -jar \$PILON_JAR \\ --genome $fasta \\ --output ${prefix} \\ $args \\ --$pilon_mode $bam
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": pilon: \$(echo \$(pilon --version) | sed 's/^.*version //; s/ .*\$//' ) END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
Automatically improve draft assemblies and find variation among strains, including large event detection
**nf-core Module**
This tool is automatically generated from nf-core modules repository.
Module: pilon Container: ${ workflow.containerEngine ==
**More Information**
For more information about this tool, visit: https://github.com/nf-core/modules/tree/master/modules/nf-core/pilon ]]>
